high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing on a beach, taking a selfie. The individual has long, dark hair that is slightly tousled by the wind. They are wearing large, dark sunglasses and a dark-colored jacket with a high collar. The background shows a sandy beach with some scattered debris, including what appears to be plastic bottles and other small items washed up on the shore. The ocean is visible in the distance, with waves gently rolling onto the beach. The sky is overcast, giving the scene a somewhat muted and cool tone.
